transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's nice to meet you too. Um, well, I guess what made me finally decide to come in is... lately, after a really long day on the construction site, or sometimes after dealing with stressful neighborhood meetings, I'll get home and just eat way more than I ever intended to. It's like I just start grabbing whatever is around—leftover takeout, cereal, a whole bag of chips—and I just keep going until I'm, like, really uncomfortably full. It's just been bothering me.
After eating this way, do you ever try to compensate by making yourself vomit or using laxatives?

Yeah... I do. Well, not every time, but maybe a few times a month after those really bad nights. I'll go into the bathroom and make myself throw up. I just start to panic, honestly, about undoing all the work I’ve put into looking put-together. I haven't used laxatives or anything like that, but yeah, I do make myself sick sometimes.
In a typical week, how many times do you have an episode of eating this way followed by making yourself vomit?

Well, looking back over the last few months... it probably averages out to about once a week. It fluctuates, though. Like, some weeks it might happen twice if things are really stressful, and then other weeks it won't happen at all. But yeah, if I had to give an average, I'd say about weekly.

latest_inference.note: Weekly binge episodes with recurrent self-induced vomiting over several months support bulimia nervosa; binge-eating disorder is less likely because compensatory vomiting is present.
